bias: 'Tonight would be a great night to re-read the weekly plan.' Bulls have done everything they needed so far; Thursday shapes up as the first test of a level sellers MUST defend — ES 7815-20 (or quicks above), NQ an excursion above 30210-237 (which he still expects to be taken out initially). For sellers to assert themselves from here or higher they must take out today's low. Buyers must flip 7815-20 to support (not far) and on NQ at least 210-237, but really reclaim 30520-546. The daily is framing higher on ES (Tuesday took out Monday's low and bullish engulfed), so anything bearish needs a prior day low taken out WITHOUT a bullish engulf. Bulls own the 30-min (higher highs/lows); daily and weekly are in balance; monthly still bulls', with the NQ multi-month LAAF an asterisk. Today's ETH closed right below Friday's RTH high.
wildcard: Today's nasty intraday selloff could have produced a LAAF of Friday's high — but it was many times the intraday straddle, so reversion was not surprising. Today's low is a structural higher low, and the news pullback low can be one too if we make a higher high. Every nominal new high this week has been sold with no damage — be cautious chasing. Between 210-237 and 520-546 the structure is very thin: he won't randomly short in there; one foot out the door on long runners.
